responsibility: Implements the AVX-512 VNNI + AVX-512VL intrinsic header for 128-bit and 256-bit packed dot-product accumulate operations. It supplies macro and inline wrappers for dpbusd/dpbusds and dpwssd/dpwssds with masking on __m128i and __m256i, extending VNNI functionality to VL-sized vectors rather than the full 512-bit forms in avx512vnniintrin.h.
